annotations.title: Make a pack of your items

description: Requires a JWT (never an rk_ key). Create — or retitle, keyed by slug — a PACK of items you own: slug (lowercase, digits, - _; ≤60), title (≤120), description (≤2000). Then add items with pack_items_set and price the pack with product_set {kind:'pack', ref:<pack id>, model, price_cents}. A pack with no price grants nothing. You keep 80% of each pack sale.
name: pack_create
title: Make a pack of your items
